content_sections.heading: DHS Ranipet Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: District Health Society (DHS), Ranipet, has released the DHS Ranipet Recruitment 2026 notification for recruitment to 13 different posts under Siddha, TB, Medical & Rural Health Service, DPH and IDSP sections. A total of 26 vacancies have been announced, including 13 vacancies for MTM HI and 2 vacancies for Urban Health Nurse, while the remaining posts have 1 vacancy each. The applications are invited through offline mode, and the completed application must reach the office on or before 01 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. content_sections.heading: DHS Ranipet Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The DHS Ranipet vacancy list has 26 vacancies in total. MTM HI has the highest number of vacancies (13), followed by Urban Health Nurse (2). Every other post has 1 vacancy. The notification does not give a category-wise (reservation) break-up of these vacancies.

content_sections.heading: DHS Ranipet Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The DHS Ranipet last date is 01.10.2026. The notification states that completed applications must be submitted by 5:00 PM on this date.

content_sections.heading: DHS Ranipet Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The notification lists a salary figure (in Rs.) against each post. The salary period (for example, per month) is not stated in the notification table.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHS Ranipet Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: DHS Ranipet Apply Online is not available as per the notification, because applications are accepted offline. Candidates can follow these steps. Visit the official website https://ranipet.nic.in for the notification, further details on the posts, qualification and the application form. Fill in the application form and attach the required documents (listed below). Submit the application by post to the address given below, or drop it in the application box placed at the same office. Make sure the application reaches the office on or before 01.10.2026, 5:00 PM. Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Identity proof (Aadhaar card) Community certificate Certificate for differently-abled / widow / deserted by husband / third gender candidates, where applicable Other documents The Tamil text of the PDF is partly garbled, so the wording of the fourth document is reconstructed from the readable characters. Candidates should confirm it in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: DHS Ranipet Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are temporary. The posts will not be made permanent at any time. Candidates can be removed from service at any time for administrative reasons. A self-declaration letter of willingness to join must be submitted for joining. An agreement (contract) is to be signed within a period of months after joining. The exact number of months is not clearly readable in the provided PDF. Increasing or reducing the vacancies, and rejecting applications, is at the discretion of the District Health Society administration. Applications are accepted at the office application box or by post.

faq.question: Q1. What is Ranipet DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Ranipet DHS Recruitment 2026 is a notification by the District Health Society, Ranipet, inviting applications for 13 posts with 26 vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Ranipet DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 26 vacancies in total. MTM HI has 13 vacancies, Urban Health Nurse has 2, and each of the other posts has 1.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Ranipet DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 01.10.2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Ranipet DHS posts?
faq.answer: The qualification varies by post, from 8th pass or 10th fail (Lab Attender) to M.B.B.S. (Medical Officer, TB). The full post-wise qualification is given in the qualification section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Ranipet DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Ranipet DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Ranipet DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted offline. Candidates can send the application with documents by post to the Executive Secretary, District Health Society, B Block, 3rd Floor, Collectorate Complex, Ranipet District – 632403, or drop it in the application box at the same office, on or before 01.10.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Ranipet DHS posts?
faq.answer: Salary ranges from Rs. 10,000 (Attender, MPHW) to Rs. 63,000 (Medical Officer, TB), as listed in the notification. The salary period is not stated.
